scope: Exact archived projected-sizing coverage and vertical count-budget diagnosis; no native initialization, mesh generation or field solve
coverage_rule: Exact rational clipped union/multiplicity for canonical footprints, stored projected Box cores, and their coordinate-expanded Thickness envelope; no real x/y mesh
workload_rule: A/h_near^2 + (A_domain-A)/h_far^2 for each of the three step-field scenarios; dimensionless geometric index only, not a node prediction, transition replay or achieved mesh-size bound
vertical_rule: Unchanged canonical z-only midpoint/face-band planner with nominal spacings; exact owner-group retained intervals and canonical volume closure
budget_rule: Original capture/3D caps unchanged; floor(Nmax/Nz) node allowance; triangle sufficient budget using maximum retained intervals and necessary ceiling using minimum retained intervals
log_rule: One unambiguous native node/mixed-element total per archived log; conditional full-column bound only, no inferred sentinel triangle count or audited packet
repeat_rule: Byte-identical complete local1/repeat1 reports on the same archived sentinel inputs, from fresh diagnostic workers; not a native mesh repeat
infeasible_policy: Retain all diagnostic values including exceeded budgets; no candidate selection, automatic tuning or mesh retry
